Headquarters: United States (Remote)

Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal. 

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

About the Role:

The Dealer Development Manager will represent Upgrade Inc (Auto Finance Division) and promote our indirect lending programs. They will develop, maintain, and grow business partnerships between Upgrade Inc. and our dealership partners. The Dealer Development Manager is also responsible for staying up-to-date on local market conditions and industry trends. In this role, you will work with internal partners to find solutions that better serve our customers, and build long lasting relationships with key decision makers to drive growth and continuous improvement. 

This position requires residency in the Greater Nashville Area.

What You’ll Do:

Dealer Relationship Management

• Develop and maintain relationships with new and existing dealer partners

• Act as a trusted advisor to dealership owners, GMs, and F&I managers

• Conduct regular in-person dealership visits based on a structured drive schedule

• Deliver consistent follow-up and service to ensure dealer satisfaction and loyalty

Dealer Acquisition & Activation

• Identify, onboard, and activate new dealer partners

• Drive dealer sign-ups and first deals (“activation”)

• Re-engage inactive dealers (e.g., no deals in 90 days) and return them to production

• Execute onboarding training to ensure dealers understand programs and systems

Production & Volume Growth

• Achieve monthly funding and application volume goals

• Increase contracts per active dealer and overall territory production

• Focus on growing volume in Tier 3–5 segments while maintaining quality

• Drive penetration targets (e.g., 3+ and 5+ deals per dealer per month)

Credit & Deal Structuring

• Partner closely with underwriting/credit teams to structure deals effectively

• Educate dealers on program guidelines, stips, and deal packaging

• Improve pull-through by coaching dealers on submitting clean, fundable deals

Portfolio Performance & Quality

• Monitor dealer portfolio performance (delinquency, charge-offs, profitability)

• Manage dealer mix to align with company risk appetite and profitability goals

• Shift focus toward preferred collateral and higher-performing dealers

• Ensure adherence to compliance, credit policies, and documentation standards

Training & Dealer Development

• Conduct ongoing product and process training with dealership staff

• Educate dealers on value-added products 

• Provide market insights and best practices to improve dealer success

• Position the company as a relationship-driven partner vs. transactional lender

Territory & Activity Management

• Maintain a disciplined weekly drive schedule maximizing in-person dealer time

• Track and manage activity through CRM (e.g., Salesforce)

• Analyze territory performance and adjust strategy based on data

• Participate in team calls, sales meetings, and performance reviews

What We Look For:

• 2+ years of experience in indirect auto finance, auto sales, or related field

• Strong understanding of credit tiers, loan structuring, and dealership operations

• Proven ability to build relationships and drive sales growth

• Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills

• Self-motivated with strong time management and territory planning skills

• Ability to travel locally (significant field time required)

What We Offer You: 

• Competitive salary, uncapped commission and stock option plan

• Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance

• Flexible PTO

• Competitive 401(k) and RRSP program

• Opportunities for professional growth and development

• Paid parental leave

• Health & wellness initiatives

#LI-Hybrid 

For California residents: Upgrade's California Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy describes our practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of the personal information of job applicants.

Environmental & Working Conditions

Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations.

Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.

The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need.

Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position.

Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings.

Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/upgrade-dealer-development-manager-nashville-tn

We believe in never settling, and that also pertains to your growth. 

About The Role

We're looking for a Lead Product Analyst to help shape the future of our products through data-driven decision making. In this role, you'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Design, and Leadership to uncover insights, identify opportunities, and influence strategic decisions. You'll play a key role in understanding user behavior, measuring product performance, and ensuring that product investments are backed by meaningful analysis.

This is a high-impact role for someone who enjoys solving complex business problems, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is passionate about turning data into actionable insights that drive exceptional customer experiences and business growth.

Responsibilities

• Experimentation craft. Strong fundamentals in A/B testing — hypothesis framing, metric selection, power analysis, cohort-level lift analysis, and disciplined readouts. Knows the difference between statistical and practical significance and is comfortable challenging poorly designed experiments. 
• User-level behavioral insight. Reasons about individual user journeys, not just aggregate metrics. Can identify meaningful behavioral archetypes from raw activity, distinguish correlation from causation, and connect what users do to what the product offers. 
• Roadmap influence and opportunity sizing. Translates analysis into prioritized recommendations. Comfortable telling a PM "this won't move the metric you care about" before the work is built. Can size the financial impact of an opportunity and stack-rank it against other bets. 
• Strong technical foundation. Expert in SQL on large datasets. Comfortable with Python for analysis and modeling. Fluent in BI tools (Tableau or equivalent). Comfortable with regression, classification, and basic ML for propensity, LTV, or churn prediction. 
• Agentic AI fluency. Has a real point of view on AI tooling for analytics. Can prompt and orchestrate agents effectively, design human-in-the-loop workflows, and critically evaluate agent output. Treats agent output as a junior analyst's first draft — useful but always verified. 
• Communication and executive presence. Writes for executives — leads with the answer, not the method. Can compress a complex analysis into a 3-bullet recommendation. Calibrated about uncertainty. Updates publicly when wrong. 
• Domain judgment. Knows when to stop analyzing. Recognizes when 80% confidence with speed beats 95% confidence with delay. Pushes back on stakeholders constructively. 

Key Competencies

• 10+ years of analytics experience, with at least 3 years in product analytics, growth analytics, or a closely related function. 
• Demonstrated ownership of high-impact analyses that influenced a product roadmap or strategy decision. 
• Hands-on experience designing and measuring product experiments at scale — not just reading dashboards. 
• Proven background in a transactional or two-sided marketplace product (gaming, fintech, e-commerce, marketplaces). Experience with payment funnels or fraud analytics is strongly preferred. 
• Strong SQL and BI background; Python or equivalent for analysis and modeling. 
• Bonus: hands-on experience building or deploying agent-based or AI-augmented analytics workflows. 
• Bonus: experience in skill-based gaming, sports betting, or real-money product environments. 

Location: Onsite - Bengaluru, Karnataka

Travel Requirement: Less than 10%

Skillz embraces diversity and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As part of our commitment to diversifying our workforce, we do not discriminate on the basis of age, race, sex, gender, gender identity, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, marital status, citizenship, veteran status, or disability status, and we operate in compliance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

dc16c630e12d83fa.description: The Product Management function defines the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for platforms and capabilities that deliver customer value and enable business outcomes. By partnering closely with engineering, design, data, operations, and business teams, the function drives outcome focused product discovery and delivery, balances innovation with platform stability, and ensures disciplined prioritization and governance. The team applies modern product management practices, customer centric thinking, and data informed decision making to deliver scalable, high impact digital products across the enterprise. The Product Manager owns end to end product delivery for assigned products, platforms, or workflows, ensuring our mobile, desktop, and app platforms deliver exceptional digital experiences while aligning product strategy, discovery, and execution with defined business outcomes, customer needs, and governance requirements. The role enables predictable, high quality product outcomes by owning product backlogs and priorities, driving day to day execution, coordinating with cross functional partners, and delivering scalable, reliable product capabilities from concept through launch in line with organizational product management standards. Functional Responsibilities Own delivery of assigned product features and capabilities by managing product discovery, backlog refinement, prioritization, and acceptance, using approved product practices, tools, templates, and quality checks. Maintain audit ready product documentation, including product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, roadmap artifacts, and outcome metrics, in line with product governance and lifecycle expectations. Coordinate closely with engineering, design, data, QA, platform, and business partners to secure inputs, clarify requirements, manage dependencies, and ensure cohesive and scalable product delivery. Ensure readiness for execution by confirming availability of required inputs, design artifacts, technical dependencies, environment readiness, and stakeholder approvals; maintain regular status updates, checkpoints, and delivery tracking to enable on time and reliable product outcomes. People Responsibilities Support and guide UX designers, junior Product Managers, in day-to-day product activities, ensuring adherence to defined product practices, prioritization discipline, documentation standards, and outcome focused execution. Build effective working relationships with engineering, design, data, QA, and business partners to align on product priorities, delivery expectations, dependencies, and timelines, enabling clear communication and smooth end to end product delivery. Requirements Professional Experience and Relevant Skills 4 - 9 years of experience owning and delivering digital product capabilities within enterprise or large-scale product environments, including end to end responsibility for product backlogs, feature delivery, and measurable outcomes across the product lifecycle from conception through launch and iteration. Strong ability to apply defined product management practices, prioritization frameworks, delivery processes, governance standards, and Agile methodologies to deliver reliable, scalable product features and enhancements. Experience collaborating closely with cross functional teams including engineering, design, data, QA, operations, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, manage dependencies, and align delivery expectations across mobile, desktop, and app platforms. Working knowledge of product governance, quality, and documentation practices, including well- structured product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, roadmap artifacts, and outcome tracking. Familiarity with product and delivery tracking tools, Agile planning and execution systems, sprint or milestone checkpoints, dependency management, and regular status reporting to support predictable delivery across small to mid-scale product initiatives. Experience working within relevant industry domains (e.g., B2B, supply chain, office supplies, or adjacent enterprise ecosystems), enabling faster domain understanding and informed product decision making. Academic Qualifications and Certifications Minimum: Bachelors degree in business administration, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Preferred: Foundational or practitioner-level certifications in Agile methodologies (e.g., Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe Agilist, or PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP)) or product management certifications (e.g., AIPMM Certified Product Manager) .

CSQ127R179

Mission

The Manager (Data & AI) for Technical Solutions Engineering will be responsible for leading and growing a regional team of Data & AI technical experts in India, focused on providing resiliency and smooth operation of customer production workloads.  This leader will oversee support operations during APJ and EMEA business hours with close alignment with other global teams to ensure 24x7 support coverage through coordination with other regions.  This team resolves complex and long-running data engineering use cases raised by Databricks customers to support the success of live use cases - which includes performance optimization, ensuring resiliency of production jobs, helping customers stabilize workloads on new products and features, and more.  You will be able to understand the real-world business problems our customers are solving with data and are committed to helping them achieve reliability and performance of their systems to meet their goals.

The impact you will have:

  • Serve as the Tech Solutions Manager for an elite team of Data & AI specialists that can provide coverage of customers across EMEA & APJ business hours.
  • Grow the technical expertise of the team to support successful adoption of new products and features of the Databricks platform for customer production workloads.
  • Engage with top customers to understand how to support their business needs with their Data & AI strategy, in collaboration with field engineering and sales when required.
  • Partner with internal product engineering teams to make Databricks products better and more supportable.
  • Understand how to maintain high reliability of the Databricks platform to successfully achieve customer business goals.

Competencies & Requirements

  • Proven people leadership experience: at least 3+ years as a manager 
  • 10+ years in the IT industry, with a strong background in Software Engineering with specialization in Data Engineering, ideally with Big Data & Cloud experience.
  • Experience leading teams either in engineering, technical support, or consulting.  Support experience is not required - but customer facing experience is highly desirable.
  • Hands-on experience in at least two of the following at production scale:
    • Big Data (Spark, Hadoop, Kafka)
    • Machine Learning / Artificial Intelligence projects
    • Data Science / Streaming use cases
  • Spark expertise is a big advantage.
  • Strong background in customer-facing support leadership roles.
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills across distributed systems.
  • Strong ownership mindset with ability to thrive in a fast-paced, startup-like environment with evolving needs.
  • Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science or equivalent technical field.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

dc037c004c0ef954.description: The Finance Transformation & Process Architect is a strategic hybrid role designed for a professional who 'connects the dots' between complex financial operations and cutting-edge technology. You will be responsible for re-engineering core finance processesspecifically in Budgeting, Forecasting, and Budgetary Controland translating those needs into a robust digital architecture. You are not just a functional expert or a developer; you are the bridge that ensures technology serves financial accuracy and operational efficiency. Key Roles & Responsibilities: Project Orchestration: Lead cross-functional sprints between Finance and IT/GDIA to ensure digital tools are delivered on time and meet functional requirements. Process Architecture & Value Stream Mapping: Lead the end-to-end mapping of finance workstreams (Planning, Forecasting, Month-end Close, and Budget Control). Utilize Value Stream Mapping (VSM) and process flow charting to identify bottlenecks and 'friction points,' designing future state architectures that eliminate manual intervention. The Strategic Bridge: Act as the primary translator between Finance stakeholders and IT/Data Engineering teams. Connect the dots between business requirements and technical execution, ensuring that automated solutions solve real-world financial pain points. Systems & Data Integration: Optimize and integrate finance workflows within SAP S/4HANA and Oracle Essbase environments. Ensure that data flows seamlessly between ERP systems, process workflows, and reporting layers. Solution Design & Automation: Develop and prototype efficiency tools like Data Form, the MS Power Platform (Power Automate/Apps), or Visualization tools (e.g. Power BI). Identify the 'right tool for the job' to improve process velocity and data integrity. Agentic AI & Innovation: Identify use cases for Agentic AI and LLMs to handle cognitive finance tasks, such as automated variance analysis, complex reconciliations, and predictive forecasting. Data Strategy & Lineage: Oversee the migration of finance data into Data Lakes/EDP. Ensure a 'single source of truth' by maintaining strict data lineage and integrity across all automated reporting outputs. Digital Capability & Citizen Development: Serve as a Lead Citizen Developer and 'AI Evangelist' for the Finance team. Design and deliver hands-on training sessions to upskill colleagues on 'last-mile' technologies, including Generative AI/LLM prompt engineering, Power Platform (Power Automate/Apps), and data visualization. Your goal is to foster a culture of technical curiosity and empower the broader finance organization to build their own automated micro-solutions.Desired Technical Skills & Experience: Core Finance Expertise: Deep functional knowledge of FP&A cycles, Budgeting, Forecasting, and Budgetary Control. Must understand the accounting logic behind complex accruals and financial modeling. Systems Proficiency: Hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA and Oracle Essbase. Data Transformation & Analytics: Expert level in tools like Alteryx for ETL and data blending. Professional-grade skills in Power BI or similar tools. Automation & Low-Code: Advanced proficiency in the MS Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps). Technical Literacy: Ability to write and understand SQL for data extraction, Python for advanced modeling, and a basic understanding of APIs for system integration. Methodology: Proven experience in Lean Six Sigma tools, specifically VSM and bottleneck analysis. The ideal candidate will possess a unique blend of financial acumen and technical literacy. We are looking for 5+ years of total professional experience, demonstrated through one of the following pathways: 1: Finance-First Professional Education: Bachelors degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics, paired with a Masters or certification in Business Analytics/Data Science. OR a Qualified CA, CMA, or MBA (Finance) with certifications in digital tools (e.g., MS Power Platform, Alteryx, or Power Query). Experience: 5+ years in Finance, with at least 3+ years specifically dedicated to Finance Transformation, Systems Implementation, or Process Re-engineering. 2: Technical-First Professional Education: B.E. / B.Tech. in Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related technical field. Experience: 5+ years of total professional experience, including 23 years of proven functional experience working directly within Finance operations or processes (e.g., Forecasting, Budgeting, or Financial Reporting). Demonstrated Success: A portfolio of completed projects where you successfully bridged the gap between a manual finance process and a fully automated, scalable digital solution. .
